text-node.name: text-node
text-node.title: Text Node
text-node.description: Injects a block of free-form text into a mode's customInstructions. Drag this node onto the canvas, click it, and type the instruction text in the configuration panel.

content.title: Content
content.description: The instruction text to inject into the mode's customInstructions. Supports markdown formatting and multi-line content.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional short label displayed on the canvas node (e.g. 'Step 1 — Read file'). Does not affect the injected content.

order.title: Order
order.description: Explicit position of this text block in the customInstructions sequence. Lower numbers appear first. Nodes without an order value are appended after ordered nodes.
